title: Canonical chart tensor and extended formal monoid model data
statement:
For a commutative ring $A$, commutative multiplicative monoids $R,Q$, a chart $\alpha:R	o(A,\cdot)$ and a homomorphism $h:R	o Q$, use the monoid rings $\mathbf Z[R],\mathbf Z[Q]$ with basis $[r]$, multiplication $[r][s]=[rs]$, and the actions induced by $\alpha$ and $h$. Define the chart tensor ring $C=A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[R]}\mathbf Z[Q]$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] and its canonical base map $a\mapsto a\otimes1$. Put $G=\alpha^{-1}(A^	imes)$. Define the sharp chart monoid as the additive notation for $\operatorname{Associates}(G^{-1}R)$, the quotient of the monoid localization by association by a unit. The extended chart $G^{-1}R	o A$ sends $r/g$ to $\alpha(r)\alpha(g)^{-1}$, and the canonical map $G^{-1}R	o R^{m gp}$ sends $r/g$ to $i(r)i(g)^{-1}$, where $i:R	o R^{m gp}$ is the canonical group-completion map. For a prime $\mathfrak q$ of $C$ put $B=C_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Define its localized monomial chart $ eta:Q	o B$ by $q\mapsto(1\otimes[q])/1$ and its boundary ideal $J=\langle eta(q):q\in Q,\  eta(q)
otin B^	imesangle$.
For commutative rings $B,H$, ideals $b,J\subseteq B$, $c,L\subseteq H$, and a ring equivalence $e:B\simeq H$, define the adic-pair-equivalence predicate to mean $e(J)=L$, with $e$ continuous for the $b$-adic and $c$-adic topologies and $e^{-1}$ continuous for the reverse topologies (powers of the respective ideals are the neighborhoods of zero).
For a local commutative ring $B$, additive commutative monoid $T$, ideal $J\subseteq B$, and Boolean $m$, define the extended-formal-monoid-model predicate as follows. Write $\widehat B$ for the maximal-ideal completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. For a local coefficient ring $D$, let $H_D$ be the completion of $D[T]$ at $I_D=(\mathfrak m_D,[t]:t
e0)$, with $D[T]$ having basis $[t]$ and $[t][s]=[t+s]$, and let $K_D=([t]:t
e0)H_D$. The predicate says that there exists a nonzero complete regular local ring $D$ [def-weil-regular-scheme], complete at $\mathfrak m_D$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], together with a residue-field ring equivalence $D/\mathfrak m_D\simeq B/\mathfrak m_B$, such that: if $m=\mathrm{false}$, there is a ring equivalence $e:\widehat B\simeq H_D$ satisfying the adic-pair-equivalence predicate for $(\mathfrak m_B\widehat B,J\widehat B; I_DH_D,K_D)$; if $m=\mathrm{true}$, there are $\eta\in H_D$ and a $D$-algebra equivalence $ho:H_D/K_D\simeq D$ with $ho(\eta mod K_D)\in\mathfrak m_D\setminus\mathfrak m_D^2$, and a ring equivalence $e:\widehat B\simeq H_D/(\eta)$ satisfying the same pair predicate with the images of $I_DH_D$ and $K_D$ in $H_D/(\eta)$.
